## Summary

Yewtree Biotech AS: water damage from a burst pipe of two monitors and a desktop workstation at a client site in Kilburn. Covered under clause 4.7; reserve 6,986 dollars.

## Facts

Yewtree Biotech AS reported the loss on 15 March 2026 under policy CC-1444 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a client site in Kilburn [notice of loss]. The cause was water damage from a burst pipe, and no third party was involved [incident report]. The items are two monitors and a desktop workstation [notice of loss], [incident report]. The incident was recorded on 17 March 2026 under reference IR/2026/4156 [incident report]. The two monitors are invoiced at 4,244 dollars by Beacon Office Supply [invoice 1]. The desktop workstation is invoiced at 2,742 dollars by Crane & Sons Electronics [invoice 2].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.7 of the policy, which covers damage to contents caused by water escaping from any fixed pipe, tank or appliance [policy]. The file records the cause as a burst pipe [incident report]. Clause 4.7 carries no condition tying cover to the named premises, so the client-site location does not affect it [policy].

- Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: it concerns theft of portable equipment left unattended, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: it concerns gradual deterioration, and the file records a burst pipe with no gradual deterioration noted [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it operates only where theft is alleged, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.7. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,986 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,244 dollars and 2,742 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The policy extract in the file shows no schedule excess, and under clause 9.1 none applies where the schedule shows none [policy].
